articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, CA, Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Immix Biopharma, Inc. (“ImmixBio”, “Company”, “We” or “Us” or “IMMX”), the global leader in relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis, today announced that it will participate and host institutional investor meetings at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference being held September 14-16, 2026 in New York, NY.
